notes.title: I Love Finding Furbabies - NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the release of "I Love Finding Furbabies," the latest addition to our beloved franchise. Get ready to embark on an exciting journey filled with adorable furry friends, challenging puzzles, and stunning scenes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787592/c5e8b5b73a942e6923136d96520c0d1ee2280940.gif[/img]

"I Love Finding Furbabies" features a whopping 72 total HO scenes and minigames, split across 24 chapters. That means hours of fun and exploration as you search for hidden objects and solve puzzles in each chapter. And for the ultimate experience, be sure to check out the Collector's Edition, which includes 6 extra locations, 12 additional minigames, a set of gorgeous wallpapers, and a music player to set the perfect mood.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43787592/ce1fec9de8d15915fb3528d67ff29a13dd8ef8d0.gif[/img]

Whether you're a long-time fan of the "I Love Finding" series or a newcomer to the world of hidden object games, "I Love Finding Furbabies" is sure to delight and entertain. So don't wait any longer – download the game now and join the hunt for cute and cuddly furbabies!
